ADT_STR model and browser preprocessing attribution

Original research and implementation: Pierfrancesco Melucci, Paolo Merialdo,
Taketo Akama, Towards Realistic Synthetic Data for Automatic Drum Transcription.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09520
https://github.com/pier-maker92/ADT_STR

International, added at commit 6c4909b711c8f1697b180926052fa984e80b9279.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode

ONNX conversion and browser port: Coming Undone, Bengisu Ozaydin (2026).
Source revision: 46d9aacc81371a0dd098f5dfb3435379c4de9158
https://github.com/swwallowws/coming-undone
Optional model revision: 89a917875e272bb492311624d7536b5e27604a64
https://huggingface.co/swwallowws/coming-undone-browser-models

The ONNX publisher explicitly distributes the ADT_STR weight adaptations under
CC BY-SA 4.0. The upstream project has CC BY-SA 4.0 licensing; the original
Pierfrancesco/adt-str Hugging Face weight repository does not separately declare
a weights license. This notice records that distinction and is not an additional
permission grant from the original model authors.

Drummer's js/adt-str-dsp.js adapts the browser log-mel and resampling preprocessing
and retains that CC BY-SA 4.0 lineage. Changes include local exports and integration
with Drummer workers; the bounded decoder/session adapter is separately written.
This preprocessing file is an exception to the application-wide MIT description.
